admission: Linux nonblocking exclusive directory flock, held through daemon lifetime; cooperating recorder only; all regular file sizes counted; no pruning
controls: Refuses before database/account mutation for insufficient budget or lock contention.
Counts unknown/orphan/incomplete/temp files; rejects symlinks, special files and inspection errors.
Reserves new directory/raw/manifest/temp entry count and bounds scanning batches.
Raw cap rejects whole writes; oversized manifests refused before temporary creation.
Source failures retain account inspection/cancellation; fixed safe budget reason preserves error identity.
Authority/outcome failures retain classification priority when joined with budget error.
limits: Logical file-byte admission, not physical filesystem quota or free-space reservation.
Root/ancestors must remain stable; operators or unrelated processes must not concurrently mutate the root.
Legacy capture-output has no aggregate admission guarantee.
One recorder per root; non-Linux admission is unsupported.
No automatic retention deletion or verified reference catalog.
No PostgreSQL/WAL/bundle quota, disk alert or 24-hour soak.
Container check is an isolated negative startup case with dummy secrets/model manifest and no network/database/account/source feed.
Native race/Python/UI results are software checks, not performance, strategy quality, hosting or visual acceptance.
Original local demonstration was not recreated and has not adopted new image/logging/storage settings.
